g.text: GDHUB-126 — every review reads the project through four lenses

text.tspan: e.g. Ideation: marketing low · Demo: marketing high
tasks day 1 / day 15, closed by sprint,

g.text: The verdict is decided by the tasks and the goal; the lenses explain it
Team is context: one open task is not a missing person; hours first, a new person last
A low-weight lens is one line, never blamed for zeros it was not meant to have
Development splits work within the tasks from work outside them
same facts, the moment's own period
